deMinimis.update: Section 321 de minimis exemption for low-value shipments removed for all countries of origin.
deMinimis.impact: Shipments previously exempt under the $800 de minimis threshold are now subject to duty and formal/informal entry requirements regardless of origin.

hsTaxonomy.deletions: 97 (Works of art, collectors' pieces and antiques) — chapter retired from the UK tariff schedule

updatedContent.mfnChanges: Chapter 84 (Machinery and mechanical appliances) — updated general duty rates.
updatedContent.preferentialChanges: USMCA preferential rates updated for Chapters 61–62 (apparel) covering Mexico and Canada.
EU–Vietnam FTA preferential coverage expanded to Chapter 85 (electrical machinery). Full list of affected tariff lines has been condensed; see linked coverage reference for details.
